column3: The Hebrew presents His tent’s being there as a past occurrence; BSB uses is.
The Hebrew names war rather than weapons of war.
The Hebrew says they did not find their hands; BSB says could not lift a hand and adds last to sleep.
The Hebrew names chariot rather than rider.
The Hebrew repeats You without explicitly saying alone.
The Hebrew names the remainder of wraths rather than survivors of wrath.
The Hebrew leaves those around Him unnamed; BSB supplies neighboring lands.
The Hebrew has spirit in the singular rather than spirits.
